facts.note: Transcript gives the nine o'clock temple bell, the watch reading of twenty minutes to nine, and the uncle's scene in front of everyone. The watch is the same one throughout.
Félix went up to the library after dinner and stayed there alone.
Thump on the floor right above him in the atelier at eighteen minutes past ten by his watch. Then the repeater: ten slow deep notes counted, then doubled notes, then quick high ones not counted.

Someone went quickly up the stairs past the library door at a quarter past ten by his watch, and someone came quickly down at twenty-one minutes past ten. He did not see who in either case, and the door was shut.
Bastien Girard came in at thirty-two minutes past ten by his watch, and they sat together until the temple struck eleven.
